$comment: Brand-rename surface for ScripTree v2. A rename = edit this file + swap assets in ./assets/. Code stays untouched. Per CLAUDE.md hard rule 6.

palette.$comment: RGBA hex (without leading #); CSS-variable injection at runtime so a palette swap is hot, not a recompile.

hexagon.$comment_size: Slightly larger than a Win11 desktop icon (48 px). 56 px chosen so the hex outline has enough room for crisp antialiasing at standard 100% DPI.
hexagon.$comment_shape: Geometry is parameterised so the shape can change without rewriting the widget. Today: hexagon. Later candidates: square, octagon, rounded-square. The 'shape' name is the dispatch key in apps/shell/hexagon_window.py::compute_polygon().
hexagon.$comment_orientation: Per-shape orientation flag. For 'hexagon' the choices are 'flat-top' (horizontal top/bottom edges; vertical sides — current default) and 'pointy-top' (rotated 90°; vertical top/bottom vertices; horizontal flats on left/right). Flat-top docks naturally on the vertical axis; pointy-top docks naturally on the horizontal axis. For 'square' the value is ignored.

assets.$comment: Paths are repo-relative. Resolve via ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} or runtime equivalent.
